nuggets.text: Lions coach Jed Stugart had a 1990s country music career as "Jed Lance," opening for acts like Tim McGraw.
The Lions' Isaac Edwards returned an interception 80 yards for a touchdown with 13 seconds left in the first half of the opener.
Lions kicker Will Graham made four field goals at Stony Brook, the longest from 50 yards.
Lions quarterback Pops Battle has run for at least one touchdown in both games this season.
The Lions are one of 28 FCS teams perfect in the red zone, scoring on every trip inside the 20 so far.
Former Kansas football coach David Beaty once played for the Lindenwood Lions.
The Lions have won the Game Ball Brawl trophy over SEMO in each of the last two seasons.
The Lions reached the 2009 NAIA national championship game, falling 25-22 to Sioux Falls.
Lindenwood football is young: the Lions played their first season in 1990, beating Dana College for their first win.
Saturday is only the second meeting between the Lions and Missouri State; the first came in 2024.
